title: DeckConfigDocument
description: A merged deck config document containing projected estate inventory and presentation data.

hosts.description: Declared hosts; absent is equivalent to an empty array.

services.description: Declared services; absent is equivalent to an empty array.

sources.description: Document and configuration source declarations; absent is equivalent to an empty array.

integrations.description: External tool integrations; absent is equivalent to an empty array.

ui.description: Presentation settings: brand, theme, home page, navigation and extension overrides.

modules.description: Module settings keyed by module id; each module contributes its own section schema.

brand.description: The product name and mark the shell shows.

theme.description: The operator's theme defaults; a viewer's own choice of mode still wins.

home.description: The id of the page rendered at /, such as page:inventory/hosts; default the built-in home page.

nav.description: Sidebar group order, labels and icons, and extra nav entries.

extensions.description: Overrides by extension, page or nav entry id. They replace, never merge: false disables, an object replaces attachTo and/or config, and a later layer's attachTo or config replaces an earlier layer's whole.

pages.description: Config-defined pages (dashboards): sections of widgets, each page routed as page:ui/<id>.

allowUnsafeEmbeds.description: Let core/embed widgets show other sites' pages in sandboxed frames; default false, when each shows that embeds are off.

statusMaps.description: Named maps from a widget's values to status tones, which widget options reference by name (statusMap).

UiTone.title: UiTone
UiTone.description: A status tone: the shell picks its colours and icon; config never carries a colour.

UiStatusMap.title: UiStatusMap
UiStatusMap.description: A value's tone: its entry in values when it has one, else the first rule it satisfies, else none (neutral).

values.description: Exact values (text, numbers and booleans compared as text, such as running or 404) and their tones.

rules.description: Rules tried in order; the first whose every condition holds gives the tone. A rule with no condition matches any value.

lt.description: The value is a number, or text that is one, below this.

lte.description: The value is a number, or text that is one, at most this.

gt.description: The value is a number, or text that is one, above this.

gte.description: The value is a number, or text that is one, at least this.

eq.description: The value equals this, either way round: as numbers when either is a number and both read as one (0 matches "0.0", "404" matches 404), else as text (true matches "true").

tone.description: The tone a value matching the rule takes.

title.description: The product name in the sidebar and the document title; default estate.name, then Deck.

icon.description: An icon name from the shell's icon set, shown in place of the title's initial.

logoUrl.description: An http(s) URL or a root-relative path to a logo image, shown in place of the icon.

mode.description: The colour mode a viewer who has not chosen one sees; default system.

preset.description: The named colour preset, a contrast-tested token set; default teal.

density.description: Spacing of tables, lists and sections; default comfortable.

groups.description: Groups in sidebar order; the built-in groups not listed follow in their default order, then any other group by id. Across layers groups merge by id: a group keeps its first layer's position and a new id is appended.

items.description: Extra nav entries: external links and separators.

id.description: The group id, a built-in group or a new one.

label.description: The group heading; default the built-in heading, else the id.

icon.description: An icon name from the shell's icon set.

id.description: The entry id, in the reserved ui namespace: nav:ui/<name>, such as nav:ui/grafana.

group.description: The group the entry belongs to.

icon.description: An icon name from the shell's icon set.

group.description: The group the separator belongs to.

separator.description: Marks the entry as a separator.

attachTo.description: Where it attaches, replacing its default (and an earlier layer's attachTo) whole; an omitted slot keeps the slot, an omitted order is 100, and group (nav entries only) when omitted keeps the entry's own.

group.description: For a nav entry, the group it moves to.

config.description: Replaces the extension's config (and an earlier layer's) wholesale.

id.description: The page's name; its id is page:ui/<id>.

path.description: The page's path, such as /lab: literal segments only.

title.description: The page heading, nav label and document title.

icon.description: An icon name from the shell's icon set.

nav.description: The page's sidebar entry (nav:ui/<id>); without it the page has none.

sections.description: The page's sections, in reading order.

group.description: The nav group the entry belongs to.

label.description: The entry's label; default the page title.

columns.description: Grid columns from the md breakpoint up (one column below it); default 1.

widgets.description: The section's widgets, in reading order.

id.description: A stable name, unique on the page; its id is widget:ui/<page>.<id>. Without one, the id is positional (s<N>w<M>, a form an id may not take) and changes when widgets move.

type.description: The widget type, <module>/<name>, such as core/json.

source.description: The provider the widget reads: a provider id, or the first provider of a kind.

select.description: A JMESPath expression over the provider's data, evaluated on the server when the data changes, within fixed size and work limits.

options.description: Options of the widget type, checked against its schema.

span.description: Columns the widget spans; default 1, at most the section's columns.

name.description: Human-readable estate name shown in the shell header.

domains.description: Per-network domain suffixes keyed by network label.

additionalProperties.description: A domain suffix for the network named by the key.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name used by consumers for display.

freshness.description: Freshness defaults consumers use to derive staleness.

snapshotStaleAfter.description: ISO-8601 duration after which a snapshot is considered stale.

name.description: Host name, unique across the config.

kind.description: What kind of host this is.

purpose.description: One-line statement of what the host is for.

status.description: Declared lifecycle status rather than observed state.

hypervisor.description: Name of the host that runs this guest; required with vmid.

vmid.description: Numeric guest id on its hypervisor; required with hypervisor.

access.description: Reachability and collection-method summary, never credentials.

managedConfigs.description: Live config files mapped to source-of-truth files.

stacksRoot.description: Filesystem root under which container stacks live.

secrets.description: Opaque secret references this host depends on.

links.description: Presentation links shown on the host card.

bindings.description: Live-provider bindings keyed by provider kind.

hidden.description: Hide this host from default views without affecting validation.

network.description: Network label for this address (e.g. lan, tailnet). An open label — the same vocabulary Estate.domains keys off.

primary.description: Whether this is the host's primary address on that network.

reachable.description: Whether the host is expected to be reachable.

port.description: Network port used by the access method.

user.description: Non-secret user name used for access.

expected.description: Whether this entity is expected to be backed up.

host.description: Name of the host this service runs on.

kind.description: What kind of service this is.

purpose.description: One-line statement of what the service is for.

status.description: Declared lifecycle status rather than observed state.

stack.description: Stack directory when it differs from the service name.

secrets.description: Opaque secret references this service depends on.

links.description: Presentation links shown on the service card.

bindings.description: Live-provider bindings keyed by provider kind.

hidden.description: Hide this service from default views without affecting validation.

Bindings.title: Bindings
Bindings.description: Provider-defined live bindings keyed by provider kind.

path.description: Filesystem path to the source root.

service.description: Optional owning service name on that host.

credentialEnv.description: Environment variable name holding a credential, never its value.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the integrated tool.

deepLink.description: Optional deep-link template into the tool.

credentialEnv.description: Environment variable name holding a credential, never its value.

SecretRef.title: SecretRef
SecretRef.description: An opaque secret reference id, never a secret value.
